issue.description: Proposed by sase-1pn.4 note #1. ToolRun da99176eb6f2a348337b37d86f176280 failed once at test_agent_dismiss_persistence.py:384: remaining indexed keys incorrectly include 20260517120500 and 20260517121000. The phase reports all proposed nodes passed serially on clean base cddea47cc6 and unchanged worktree. Lander independently passed this node at 7e562f58f8. Population failure rate and root cause are unknown. Existing sase-1on covers a distinct revival test with extra loaded rows; shared index state is plausible but not established, so link rather than conflate them. Searches across task statuses and past-week sweep found no exact duplicate. Active sase-j7 covers proven process-global leaks; none is proved here. Investigate the indexed dismissal reconciliation and isolate the root cause before changing assertions; size large.
